title: From ChatGPT to DeepSeek AI: A Comprehensive Analysis of Evolution, Deviation, and Future Implications in AI-Language Models
reasoning: The paper provides a comparative analysis and performance benchmark of ChatGPT and DeepSeek AI across 24 academic and professional domains. While it contains a qualitative section on 'Ethical Considerations' and includes bias/ethics as a descriptive feature in its comparison tables, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a subject of the study.
